label: Data quality culture
definition: The organization should sustain a data quality culture. The organization shall: a) have rules and processes to achieve quality (according to this document) taking into account the data quality model as applied to the applicable products and services; b) define and implement data quality management processes, and performing related data quality activities; c) integrate the data quality management processes and activities, to the extent appropriate, into other management processes and activities, such as general quality management and risk management; d) document the performed activities; e) provide resources sufficient to perform data quality management; f) monitor, and to the extent necessary, review and improve the data quality management processes; g) provide the required authority to involved personnel; h) communicate data quality policies within the organization.

label: Management of data quality issues
definition: The organization shall meet data quality requirements by: a) having processes for communicating, analysing, evaluating, resolving and closing (implementing a resolution or giving a reason for not being an unreasonable risk) issues of data quality; b) documenting closed issues; c) escalating issues that cannot be closed.

label: Competence management
definition: The organization shall: a) document required skills and tools to process the data; b) ensure that involved persons have sufficient skills to perform their activities and duties; c) maintain proof of sufficient skill with the data quality system; d) keep appropriate records of training and experience that substantiate claims of competency.

label: Resource management
definition: The organization shall provide the resources required for data quality management, including: a) appropriate software licenses and technical support for required tools; b) required IT infrastructure or services to meet the storage and compute requirements; c) availability of skilled persons.

label: Documentation — intelligibility
definition: Documentation shall be intelligible to relevant stakeholders in accordance with their role.

label: Documentation — accessibility
definition: Documentation shall be accessible to relevant stakeholders as appropriate and authorized.

label: Data quality audit and assessment
definition: The implemented processes shall be audited when appropriate. The audit shall: a) evaluate the data quality plan against the organizational rules and processes for data quality; b) determine whether planned activities have been implemented and maintained effectively; c) identify non-compliances and propose corrective actions; d) document audit findings and conclusions; e) communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

label: Confirmation review and DQ measures
definition: Data quality shall be confirmed by appropriate data quality measures in accordance with ISO/IEC 5259-2. All work products shall undergo confirmation reviews that: a) confirm that work products meet the data specification; b) confirm that data quality measures have been applied correctly; c) identify any remaining open issues; d) authorise progression to the next life cycle stage.

label: Confirmation review — independent personnel
definition: Confirmation reviews shall be performed by personnel independent of the activities under review.

label: Project-specific DQM
definition: The organization shall manage project-specific data by: a) establishing a suitable project-specific DQM process; b) maintaining a list of relevant DQ claims with benchmarks for each milestone; c) adopting processes to identify and manage all relevant DQ measures.

label: DQMLC — specify processes
definition: The organization shall specify the processes to be performed in each stage of the DQMLC in accordance with the requirements of this document.

label: DQMLC — quality gates
definition: The organization shall ensure that each stage of the DQMLC is only entered when all quality gates for the preceding stage have been met.

label: DQMLC — document deviations
definition: The organization shall document all deviations from the defined DQMLC together with a justification and any compensating measures.

label: Data motivation and conceptualization
definition: The organization shall: a) document motivation and origin of the data need; b) specify scope, purpose and intended use of data; c) document the data quality requirements.

label: Stakeholder analysis
definition: The organization shall: a) identify all stakeholders relevant to the data and the intended use; b) document stakeholder data quality requirements and expectations.

label: Data specification General
definition: The organization shall specify data requirements in a data specification and validate that these requirements are consistent and complete for the intended use.

label: Data format specification
definition: The data specification shall include: a) the data type(s) of each data item; b) the allowed range or set of values for each data item; c) the encoding and representation standards; d) the unit of measurement for quantitative data items; e) the definition of missing or null values; f) any required data structure (e.g. tabular, hierarchical, graph); g) inter-data constraints and integrity rules; h) metadata requirements; i) versioning and provenance requirements; j) any other format constraints relevant to intended use.

label: Statistical properties — subset divisions
definition: The data specification shall include specification of valid divisions into subsets (e.g. training, validation and test data) and the criteria for assigning data items to subsets.

label: Statistical properties — representativeness
definition: The organization shall determine and maintain for each subset: relevant statistical properties, representativeness with respect to the target population, and appropriate size to meet the intended purpose.

label: Data planning General
definition: The organization shall establish a data quality plan that covers: a) the processes, activities and resources required to meet the data specification throughout the data life cycle; b) entry and exit criteria for each DQMLC stage; c) the data quality measures to be applied; d) responsibilities and authorities for DQM activities; e) schedule and milestones for DQM activities.

label: Data life cycle specific plans
definition: The organization shall establish life cycle stage-specific plans addressing: a) data acquisition plan; b) data preprocessing plan; c) data augmentation plan; d) data provisioning plan; e) data decommissioning plan.

label: Data acquisition — specify processes
definition: The organization shall specify data acquisition processes to meet the data specification and include them in the data quality plan.

label: Data acquisition — monitoring
definition: The organization shall monitor data acquisition processes to ensure compliance with the data specification.

label: Data acquisition — risk documentation
definition: Risks that arise from incompleteness of the acquired data shall be documented and mitigated.

label: Data source — delegation responsibility
definition: Documented conditions of the reuse or license of a dataset shall be taken into account. The organization can delegate data acquisition to a third party but remains responsible for meeting data quality requirements.

label: Data collection
definition: The organization shall document: a) reasons for collection, including the relationship to the data specification; b) the method of data collection; c) the data collection specification including data item descriptions; d) required resources and skills for data collection; e) anonymisation or pseudonymisation methods where applicable; f) measurement scales and units; g) expected deviations from the data specification and their justification.

label: Data handling — meets specification
definition: The organization shall ensure that collected data meets the data specification before progressing to the next DQMLC stage.

label: Data handling — processes
definition: The organization shall specify processes for data handling, including storage, access control, format conversion and integrity checking.

label: Data preprocessing — specify processes
definition: The organization shall specify data preprocessing processes to meet the data specification and include them in the data quality plan.

label: Data cleaning
definition: The organization shall specify data quality measures to be applied for cleaning, including measures for: a) missing data items; b) duplication; c) outliers; d) bias and drift; e) non-standard or invalid data values; f) unneeded or irrelevant data items; g) required transformations; h) verification that cleaning results meet the data specification; i) de-identification or anonymisation where applicable.

label: Data augmentation — specify processes
definition: The organization shall specify data augmentation processes to meet the data specification and include them in the data quality plan.

label: Data provisioning General
definition: The organization shall: a) specify data provisioning processes to meet the data specification; b) provide auditable evidence that provisioned data meets all specified data quality requirements; c) ensure that the provisioning process does not alter the data beyond what is specified; d) document all provisioning activities; e) maintain a record of all data provisioned, including version and provenance information; f) ensure that recipients are authorised to receive the provisioned data; g) ensure that provisioning complies with applicable legal and contractual obligations.

label: Data provisioning documentation
definition: Documentation provisioned with data shall include: a) scope of use and intended purpose; b) instructions for use; c) statistical properties of the dataset; d) description of each data item; e) list of stakeholders and their roles; f) duties and obligations of the recipient; g) use environment requirements; h) quality factors and their measurement results; i) acceptance test methods; j) communication strategy for updates and issue reporting.

label: Tracking — data usage monitoring
definition: The organization shall monitor the use of provisioned data to detect any degradation of data quality or deviations from the intended use.

label: Tracking — corrective actions
definition: The organization shall define and apply corrective actions when deviations or degradation are detected.

label: Tracking — improvement feedback
definition: The organization shall use tracking results as feedback to improve data quality planning and acquisition processes.

label: Data optimization
definition: The organization shall specify data optimization processes that: a) reduce storage and computational overhead without reducing quality below specified thresholds; b) apply only transformations that are documented and reversible or justified; c) validate that optimised data still meets the data specification; d) maintain a record of all optimisation operations applied.

label: Support commitment — specify
definition: The organization shall specify the support it will provide for provisioned data, including the duration of support and conditions for termination.

label: Support commitment — documentation
definition: The organization shall document all support commitments in a support agreement that covers: a) scope of support; b) response times and service levels; c) versioning and update policy; d) conditions for withdrawal of data.

label: Data decommissioning — choose method
definition: The organization shall choose an appropriate method to decommission the data either through data deletion or through data transfer to a qualified recipient.

label: Data decommissioning — specify processes
definition: The organization shall specify data decommissioning processes in the data quality plan, including the schedule and criteria for decommissioning.

label: Data transfer — conditions
definition: When transferring data, the organization shall ensure that the recipient meets the data quality requirements and has the authority to receive the data.

label: Data deletion — from all storage
definition: When deleting data, the organization shall ensure that data is deleted from all storage locations, including backups and replicas.

label: Data deletion — legal obligations
definition: The organization shall ensure that data deletion does not violate applicable legal, contractual or regulatory obligations.

label: Data deletion — confirmation
definition: The organization shall document confirmation that data has been deleted from all locations.

label: Partial deletion — identify scope
definition: When partial data deletion is requested, the organization shall identify the exact scope of data items to be deleted.

label: Partial deletion — impact assessment
definition: The organization shall assess the impact of partial deletion on the remaining dataset quality.

label: Partial deletion — execute and confirm
definition: The organization shall execute the partial deletion and confirm that the requested data items have been removed.

label: Horizontal processes General
definition: The organization shall apply the horizontal processes (verification and validation, configuration management, change management, and risk management) across all stages of the DQMLC.

label: V&V — apply throughout
definition: The organization shall apply verification and validation processes throughout all stages of the DQMLC.

label: V&V — independent personnel
definition: Verification and validation activities shall be performed by personnel with appropriate independence from the activities being verified or validated.

label: Quality gates — define criteria
definition: The organization shall define quality gate criteria for each DQMLC stage in the data quality plan.

label: Quality gates — enforce progression
definition: A DQMLC stage shall only be entered when all quality gate criteria for the preceding stage have been met and documented.

label: Quality gates — deviations
definition: Any deviation from quality gate criteria shall be documented with a justification and approved by appropriate authority before progression.

label: Quality gates — objectively measurable
definition: Quality gate criteria shall be objectively measurable using defined data quality measures.

label: Configuration management — identify items
definition: The organization shall identify all configuration items (data, data specifications, plans, tools, and work products) subject to configuration management.

label: Configuration management — version control
definition: The organization shall implement version control for all configuration items to ensure traceability and reproducibility.

label: Configuration management — baseline
definition: The organization shall establish and maintain baselines for configuration items at defined DQMLC milestones.

label: Configuration management — status accounting
definition: The organization shall maintain records of the status of all configuration items throughout the DQMLC.

label: Change management planning
definition: The organization shall establish and maintain a change management process that ensures all changes to data, requirements or processes are assessed and approved before implementation.

label: Change request specification
definition: Each change request shall specify: a) the data item or process affected; b) the reason for the change; c) the proposed change; d) the requestor and date.

label: Change request analysis
definition: Change requests shall be analysed to determine: a) impact on data quality; b) impact on dependent datasets, processes and plans; c) risks introduced by the change; d) alternative solutions; e) resources required; f) impact on schedule.

label: Change request evaluation and approval
definition: Change requests shall be evaluated and: a) approved, with conditions if necessary; b) deferred to a later stage; c) rejected with justification.

label: Change implementation — implement
definition: Approved changes shall be implemented in accordance with the approved change request and all affected configuration items shall be updated.

label: Change implementation — verify
definition: The organization shall verify that the implemented change achieves the intended objective without introducing unacceptable side effects.

label: Risk management — conduct assessment
definition: The organization shall conduct a risk assessment and maintain documentation with respect to risks associated to data quality.

label: Risk management — minimise risks
definition: The organization shall manage and maintain appropriate processes to minimise identified risks. Risks shall be specified, justified and documented.

label: Risk management — monitor
definition: The organization shall monitor identified risks throughout the DQMLC and update the risk assessment when the risk environment changes.

label: Risk management — communicate
definition: The organization shall communicate significant data quality risks to relevant stakeholders.

label: Data processing tools — management
definition: The organization shall manage data processing tools to ensure they support data quality requirements, covering: a) approved tool list with version information; b) tool qualification and validation; c) access control and licensing; d) backup and recovery; e) monitoring of tool-induced data quality issues; f) tool change management; g) documentation of tool-specific data quality constraints.

label: Data quality dependencies — management
definition: The organization shall manage data quality dependencies by: a) identifying all data quality dependencies between datasets and processes; b) documenting the impact of dependency failures on data quality; c) specifying mitigation strategies for dependency-related quality risks.
